Subject: Conditional release request — INV-33221

Hi Mariana / AP team,

Following up on invoice INV-33221 for Synapse Labs (period Aug 1–Aug 31). We have the invoice attached but before finance can release payment over ACH we need two quick confirmations to satisfy our treasury controls:

1) A completed bank authorization (attached as a filled stub / scanned bank letter is fine). Please confirm the beneficiary name exactly as it appears on the account and the IBAN.
2) VAT handling confirmation — indicate whether you will remit EU VAT on your side or require us to withhold (we have Synapse set up as VAT-registered in DE in our system, but need explicit confirmation for this invoice).

If you can return those items within 48 hours we’ll push the payment through our ACH sweep on the next business day. If ACH isn’t possible, we can accept a wire; let us know the preference and any required beneficiary reference.

Quick summary of asks:
- Attach bank authorization / scanned bank letter (or micro-deposit confirmation)
- Confirm VAT treatment for INV-33221 (VAT ID and whether Synapse will reclaim)
- Confirm PO number for customer internal routing (if different from the invoice header)

Attachments: INV-33221.pdf (invoice), redwood_W9.pdf (for your records).

Thanks — happy to hop on a 15-min call if that helps speed this.

Best,
Olga Petrov
Revenue Operations Manager
Redwood Inference
olga.petrov@redwoodinference.com
+1 (415) 555-0183

---
Note: Our standard net terms are NET 30, but we can accommodate NET 45 for first-time cross-border ACH on a case-by-case basis.

Mariana — perfect, thanks for the quick turnaround and for attaching the bank authorization.

We confirm:
- Beneficiary name and IBAN received (will match exactly in our payments system).
- VAT ID recorded: DE258974321 — we will not withhold VAT for this invoice (we’ll mark the invoice as VAT-reclaimable in our ledger).
- PO added to payment reference: SL-PO-2027-356.

Two next steps from our side to complete the release:
1) Finance needs a micro-deposit confirmation to the Synapse account (our treasury uses micro-deposits as a final validation step for new beneficiary records). If you prefer, we can accept an on-bank-letterhead confirmation stamped by your bank instead — either is fine.
2) Please confirm preferred currency for payment: if you want EUR, we will initiate an EUR wire; if you prefer USD ACH, we will route via our FX partner (please note FX spread may apply). Indicate preference and Redwood team will proceed.

If we get the micro-deposit or bank letter and the currency choice by EOD (your timezone) tomorrow we’ll target payment on our next sweep (Oct 6).

Thanks — cc’ing Ben and Laura for visibility on the timing.

Best,
Olga
Revenue Operations Manager
Redwood Inference
